@@U02442@@
to threaten the treasure of crowns, chains and rings.

@@U02444@@
—Look there, look! —Look at it well up! —Filled to the brim! —Golden vessels melting! —Rolls of gold coins tumbling! —Ducats dance as if being minted! —Oh, how my heart leaps! —All my desires! —Roll and spin across the floor! —lIt’s offered! —Take it! —Bend and scoop it up! —We'll be rich! —The rest of us take the chest!

@@U02446@@
What's this? Idiots! You think it’s real? You think it’s gold? It’s a joke, a masquerade prank! Enough greed for one night! Counter chips would be too good for you! Fools! Taking a pretty effect for crude truth! What good is truth to you? Snatchers at illusion! 普路托斯, masked hero, master of mummery, drive them away for me!

@@U02448@@
I dare say your staff will do. Lend it to me. I'll dip it deep
translation:
@@U02442@@
威胁王冠、锁链和戒指的宝藏。

@@U02444@@
——看那儿，看！ ——仔细看看！ ——满满的！ ——金器融化！ ——一卷金币翻滚！ —金币跳舞就像被铸造一样！ ——噢，我的心在狂跳！ ——我所有的愿望！ —在地板上滚动和旋转！ ——提供了！ ——拿着！ ——弯腰把它舀起来！ ——我们会变得富有的！ ——剩下的人拿走箱子！

@@U02446@@
这是什么？白痴！你认为这是真的吗？你以为它是金子？这是一个玩笑，一个化装舞会的恶作剧！一晚就够贪心了！计数器芯片对你来说太好了！傻瓜！为粗俗的真相带来漂亮的效果！真理对你有什么好处？幻境中的掠夺者！ 普路托斯，蒙面英雄，哑剧大师，给我把他们赶走吧！

@@U02448@@
我敢说你的员工会做的。借给我吧。我会把它浸得很深
